tools.name: swap_route.quote
tools.description: Get a read-only Paraswap price quote on Base. The response identifies the actual venues returned by Paraswap. No transaction construction, execution, custody, or fee collection.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "swap_route.quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get the best swap route across Uniswap v3 (Base), Jupiter (Solana), and OKX DEX. Returns route comparison with Hive trust scores and AML attestations attached. Hive charges 5 bps trust + receipt fee. Actual liquidity is from partner DEXes. No authentication required." → after: "Get a read-only Paraswap price quote on Base. The response identifies the actual venues returned by Paraswap. No transaction construction, execution, custody, or fee collection."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "swap_route.execute" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
